notes.title: Update V1.2
notes.content:
BATTLERCORE: TEAM BLAZER
Game Ver.1.2 Update Patch Notes

[previewyoutube=GNFKnn-SOxs;full][/previewyoutube]

🔹 New Features Added
Save/Load System Upgrade
Save and load with detailed play data display.

New Game Mode: Arena
Enter the Arena mode with Tier 2 Units or higher from all Factions.

New Trading System
Trade unique items and 13 new types of support weapons.

Rescue and Treasure Recovery System
Added mechanics to rescue characters and retrieve hidden treasures during missions.

Battlercore Startup Mechanic
Core activation/deactivation now occurs when entering/exiting the mech.

New Units and Mini-Bosses
Over ten new MERC units and mini-boss types added.

Special Collection Items
Discover rare items in the Collections system. These can be found through treasure boxes in Extraction Mode and other maps via random drops.

🔧 Changes and Improvements
Mission Overhaul
Early game missions have been revamped. A new Rescue Mission has been added to the main story.

Cooking Minigame Tweaks
Simplified gameplay and reduced time required.

Merc Unit Redesign
All original Merc units have been replaced with new unique characters. These appear in Expedition Mode, as random mini-bosses, and in the Arena.

Visual Enhancements
Various visual elements and effects across the game have been updated.

Shoulder Armor Fold Feature Temporarily Removed
Feature disabled due to technical issues. Will return in a future patch.

Dialogue Audio Adjustment
Field dialogues now use radio voice clips only for select lines.

Boss Ability Updates
Bosses now feature new special abilities and status effects.

notes.title: DEMO V.1.1.2.3b
notes.content:
Patch Notes DEMO V.1.1.2.3b

Added


 Random item spawns have been added across various locations in NEST mode.  
 New Ace Tier 5 units added for both Centradia and Esthan factions.


Changes


 General improvements to AI behavior.  
 Enemy factions will now deploy large numbers of Tier 4-5 units once their War Board score exceeds 30 points.
 Ace-tier units now have a chance to respawn every 120 seconds during missions.  
Esthan Tier 4 (Azure)** units are no longer classified as Ace units, as they’ve been replaced by the Zero unit.  
 Mansion units in Santuario can now be built with two floors.  
 Removing Facilities in the Hideout zone of Santuario will fully refund all resources. In contrast, removing them in the Mansion zone will only refund Credits in full.  
 The Mine Layer equipment now has an increased placement range and a 1.5-second delay to prevent accidental detonation during mine deployment.


Bug Fixes


Fixed a bug where minute calculations in NEST mode could result in negative values.

notes.title: DEMO V 1.1b – NEST Update

DEMO V 1.1b – NEST Update

Added
- Introduced a brand-new "NEST" system, allowing players to enjoy a life simulation experience with the girls aboard Prominus 1 in a 2D side-scrolling format.

notes.title: Devlogs #1 [New NEST Features]
notes.content:
Hello, Liberators!

I've decided to start doing Devlogs to keep you updated on the progress of the full version of the game. While preparing for the Steam Fest in June, we've been adding new features to enhance the experience. However, this also means that the full release will be pushed to Q4. I want to ensure that the Life Sim and character relationship aspects feel more polished, along with revamped adult content.

Today, I’m excited to reveal the newly revamped NEST System! Instead of relying on random events like before, players will now be able to freely explore and interact with different elements—including the Waifus—directly aboard the ship. Each character will have their own daily routines, meaning they'll be in different locations at specific times instead of appearing randomly. This allows for better time management and planning for daily activities.

Speaking of time, the old Action Points system (which previously allowed three activities per session) has been replaced with a real-time system. Each in-game day now consists of 24 hours, divided into three phases: Daytime, Evening, and Nighttime.

For those who want to dive deeper into the game's development, discuss content, and share their love for Mecha, feel free to join our Discord community here! SCARLET-G
